pm.seasoning: skipped, the tool was needed back early

claims.statement: PM-707 on DEP02-A was wet clean with wall buildup removed and seasoning skipped, pre-PM recipe time 61.77 s and baseline clean time 60.0 s, target 500.0 A.
History shows wet clean with skipped seasoning had first wafers vs later -9.42 A and thickness slope -0.07 A per lot, versus wet clean with seasoning had -0.19 A.
Metrology matching shows reference 500.0 A reads MET02 499.71 A and MET01 499.79 A, MET02 minus MET01 -0.08 A checked 10.1 hours ago.
Monitor 1 at 61.77 s on MET02 measured 512.58 A with implied rate 8.2982 A per s, runs since PM 1.
Monitor 2 at 61.77 s on MET02 measured 509.71 A with rate 8.2517 A per s, runs since PM 2.
Monitor 3 at 61.77 s on MET02 measured 523.04 A with rate 8.4676 A per s, runs since PM 3.
Monitor 4 at 61.77 s on MET02 measured 524.32 A with rate 8.4883 A per s, runs since PM 4.
Estimate from monitor 3 and monitor 4 gives rate 8.4779 A per s and recipe 58.98 s for 500.0 A, change -4.52 pct vs pre-PM, pre-PM time would give 523.68 A.

release.summary: Wet clean raised rate so old 61.77 s runs thick. Skipped seasoning caused thin first wafers at 512.58 and 509.71 A, settled monitors 3-4 at 523.04 and 524.32 A give new time 58.98 s for 500 A inside 8 pct limit. Metrology offset negligible. No drift expected, use default EWMA 0.3.
